environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed in default VPC configuration with API Gateway (REST API, no request validation). Lambda execution role has s3:PutObject and s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::user-content-store-prod/*. No WAF attached to API Gateway stage. S3 bucket has no bucket policy restrictions. Lambda accesses S3 via public endpoint.

config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validators, no WAF
